svg.title: Certificate of participation — UNOFFICIAL READING COPY
svg.text: UNOFFICIAL READING COPY
PORTFOLIO TRANSLATION / TRANSCRIPTION
Certificate of participation
Nedaye Omid · lifesaving event
In the name of the Exalted God
Dear Athlete,
With the help of Almighty God, the valuable instruction of your coaches and your
own efforts, you participated in the first edition of the lifesaving competitions,
“Nedaye Omid Festival,” in the year 1403, in [handwritten county name not
confidently legible], and are therefore awarded this certificate.
We hope that, relying on Almighty God, you will be successful in all your life’s
goals, particularly in advancing and developing the sport of lifesaving.
Printed organisational marks include the East Azerbaijan Lifesaving and Diving
Board and the Lifesaving and Diving Federation of the Islamic Republic of Iran.
Reading notes: only the readable main text is translated. The small decorative
header quotation and unclear signature or stamp details are not reconstructed. No
individual recipient name or rank is printed in the main text. This is a participation
record, not a professional lifeguard qualification or licence.
Dates retain the Solar Hijri calendar. No seal or signature is recreated.
The supplied original is authoritative. This is not an official reissue.
